adapter_policy: One reader of the media files of a process for all its decoders (user 2026-10-12: breaking news is edited straight from the camera card, no copy). Each decoder reads its file through a stream of blocks in memory; one thread reads the blocks a decoder waits for at once (small reads), another reads ahead of every open stream in long sequential runs, the stream with the least read ahead first. Streams of the same file share its blocks; memory stays within a budget and goes with the last stream of a file. Files are opened for reading only; nothing is written, created, renamed or removed (a card is read only). It knows no format, decodes nothing, runs no probe and reads no database.
